Select approved drugs with phase 4 status and an infection indication. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication and map indication details via EFO. Retrieve chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, EFO ID as indication_curie, indication label as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Use INNER JOIN compound_structures to enforce presence of canonical_smiles.
